[[File:Granite cannonball detail.png|left|150px]]
'''Granite cannonballs''' are [[ammunition]] used for a [[dwarf multicannon]], as well as for a [[Cannon (facility)|boat cannon]] during [[boat combat]]. They can be fired from [[adamant cannon]]s or stronger. They are created at level 50 [[Smithing]] by using a [[steel cannonball]] on [[granite dust]], granting no experience.

Granite cannonballs increase the [[max ranged hit|max hit]] of the dwarf multicannon from 30 to 35, equating to an approximate damage per second increase of 16.67%.

When a player creates granite cannonballs, a message in the chatbox will state ''You apply a thick coating of granite dust to your steel cannonballs.''

If a player is killed by another player in the [[Wilderness]] or a [[PvP world]], the killer will receive steel cannonballs.

==Trivia==
*Granite cannonballs had a festive override to look like [[wikipedia:Christmas pudding|christmas pudding]]s during the [[2017 Christmas event/Gallery|2017]], [[2018 Christmas event/Gallery|2018]], and [[2019 Christmas event/Gallery|2019]] Christmas events. The override had a darker colour in 2018 compared to 2017 and 2019. Upon the 2019 event ending, the colour was accidentally changed to be identical to regular [[cannonball]]s, which was fixed the following week.
